description: A polyphonic virtual OTA state-variable filter with a drive stage in front of it and an accent input that lifts the cutoff

params.text: Sets the resonance, from none at the counter-clockwise end up to 99% at the clockwise end
Sets how hard the input is driven into the filter; the driven signal is clipped at 9.99V before it reaches the filter core
Attenuates one of the two frequency CV inputs before it is added to FREQUENCY
Picks one of the filter's three models
Sets how long the accent envelope takes to fall away after each pulse

inputs.text: Moves the cutoff, added to FREQUENCY at a sixth of that knob's travel per volt, with no attenuator in the way
Moves the cutoff, added to FREQUENCY and scaled by its own attenuator, which reaches a twelfth of that knob's travel per volt at the clockwise end
The audio input, and the jack the module takes its polyphony channel count from
A pulse above 1V fires the accent envelope, which multiplies the cutoff by up to two and lets it fall back

notes: the module follows the number of channels at the audio input, up to sixteen; the frequency CV jacks are read channel by channel, so a one-channel cable there moves only the first voice
the accent envelope is only advanced while a cable is in the accent input; pull that cable out part way through a fall and the cutoff keeps whatever lift the envelope had reached

inputs.0:
continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage subtracts from the knob.
inputs.1:
continuous · polyphonic

unpatched it reads 0V; a negative voltage subtracts from the knob.
